fee_notes: Roosters charges a Development Fee (which serves as the full franchise fee) rather than a separate initial franchise fee. Single Shop Program: $39,500 for 1 shop. Fast Start Program: $69,500 for 3 shops, $99,500 for 6 shops, plus $10,000 for each additional shop beyond 6 (e.g., $109,500 for 7 shops). During the last fiscal year, Development Fees ranged from $0 to $39,500. Fees are non-refundable. In multi-shop development, $39,500 is allocated to the first shop, $20,000 to the second, and $10,000 to each additional shop.

Fast Start Program (Note 2): Development Fee Amount (3 Shop): $69,500 | Development Fee Amount (6 Shop): $99,500 | Development Fee Amount (6+ Shop): $10,000 for each additional Shop
During last fiscal year, our Development Fees ranged $0 to $39,500.
